string.text: Keeps snowfall active at all times outdoors (when Project INVERNO is installed), varying organically between light drifting snow, thick snowflakes, heavy snow, and blizzards without dry clear gaps.
Leaves directional 3D-shaded left/right bootprints, sprint scuffs, and jump landing craters in snow that gradually fill back in as snow continues to fall.
Nearby stalkers and mutants (within 35m) leave directional boot and species-scaled paw trails in the snow so you can track them across the Zone.
Controls how long footprints and craters stay visible before falling snow buries them (1.0 = ~45s in blizzards up to ~140s in light snow).
Lit campfires gradually melt surrounding snow into thawed dark earth and wet slush. Once extinguished, fresh snowfall slowly buries the firepit again.
Maximum radius around a burning campfire where snow melts away.
Enable Snow Craters & Tree Snow Shake
Gunshots and explosions churn craters in snow, kick up snow dust, and shake falling snow cascades loose from tree branches.
